name: Indoge Social Share Pro
author: indoage

sections.description:
Indoge Social Share Pro lets you easily display floating social media buttons on your WordPress site with stylish designs and complete customization options.

Key Features:
– Add social links: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter.
– Show or hide individual social links as needed.
– Choose from 4 unique design layouts:
1. Bottom Right Toggle
2. Left Centered Fixed
3. Ribbon Tabs
4. Circular Orbit
– Mobile-friendly and responsive design.
– Simple and intuitive admin interface.

Use Case Examples:
– Add a fixed set of social links to promote your profiles.
– Highlight specific campaigns or platforms with social buttons.
– Use creative layouts like Circular Orbit for a unique user experience.

No coding knowledge required — just install, configure, and publish your floating social buttons.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the indoge-social-share-pro folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. In the WordPress admin dashboard, click the Indoge Social Share Pro menu to configure your social links.
  4. Choose your preferred display design and save changes.
sections.faq:
Can I hide specific social buttons?

Yes. In the settings page, simply disable the social links you don’t want to display.

Are the designs responsive?

Yes, all designs are responsive and adapt to mobile, tablet, and desktop views.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.
